stages.name: Foundation
stages.work: Glute bridge → straight-leg bridge; thoracic extension over a roller; overhead reach against a wall, ribs down; wrist prep
ready: arms overhead flat to the wall

exercises.name: Wrist extension rocks
exercises.cue: Kneeling, palms down, rock forward and back.

exercises.name: Thoracic extension over a roller
exercises.cue: Roller at mid-back, hands behind the head, extend over it with the ribs down.

exercises.name: Overhead reach against a wall
exercises.cue: Back to the wall, ribs down, arms overhead pressed flat to the wall. Stop where the back starts to arch.

exercises.name: Straight-leg bridge
exercises.cue: Hips high, glutes tight, ribs down. Bend the knees (glute bridge) if the straight-leg version cramps.

stages.name: Hands high
stages.work: Bridge with hands on a high bench, lowering the surface over time

stages.name: Hands low
stages.work: Bridge from a low platform (20 → 10 cm)

stages.name: Full bridge, floor
stages.work: Press up from lying to a full bridge, controlled
ready: 3 × 8 and one 30 s hold, arms and legs straight

stages.name: Wall walk-down
stages.work: Stand near a wall, walk the hands down into a bridge and back up

stages.name: Closing the bridge
stages.work: From a full bridge, walk the hands toward the feet, shoulders over hands

stages.name: Stand-to-stand
stages.work: Stand → bridge → stand, with a wall assist first, then free
ready: 3 consecutive free reps, no momentum drop
